summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.37/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.37 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 19, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest in WPR's 8 months of tracking. AAA figures put the statewide average 28¢ lower than a week ago, 70¢ lower than a month ago, and 72¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Sheboygan ($3.08) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.86).
